notes.notes:
* Added Czech localization (thanks to siSINka)
* Fixed a bug that caused the BGM to stop playing in rare cases
Added Japanese localization (thanks to Hiroshi Ashida)

[list]
[*] Moved letter closer to the camera when inspecting to improve readability
[*] Can now also rotate objects with left analog stick when inspecting
[*] Default look sensibility for controllers increased
[*] Increased size of crosshair
[*] Now drops inspected objects when pausing
[/list]
Possibly fixed an issue where the "Acquired Taste" achievement did not unlock when the can was dispensed.

Machines will no longer apply the state of a rule when the rule causes the machine to stop as a result of invalid pointer movement. That's not really a gameplay change rather that a visual enhancement since machines sometimes showed the wrong state after they stopped.

notes.title: Re:Touring is a clever, accessible and polished first-person puzzler
notes.notes:
If you enjoy first-person puzzlers like Portal and The Talos Principle then you'll likely feel right at home with Re:Touring.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/05/retouring-is-a-clever-accessible-and-polished-first-person-puzzler

[list]
[*] Adds the possibility to reset the cube in level 20
[*] A happy tune is now playing when solving the sakura machine in level 22
[/list]

[h1]23.5.855103755: Memorize Machine[/h1]

The state of the machine can now also be memorized like solution panels and other elements.
This does not apply to the very first machine of the game to not overwhelm players.
